milestone: Stage 2 Raw Telemetry Dynamic Validation for Three Candidate Relationships

created_files.description: Automated runner script extracting raw 1Hz episodes, performing FOPDT model fitting on development episodes, held-out validation, and plotting.
Comprehensive unit tests covering dataset SHA-256 integrity, cadence audit, episode extraction, startup/shutdown separation, leakage prevention, and model metrics.
Auditable event table containing all 37 extracted physical transitions across P301, MV201, and P101 with timestamps, states, delays, and inclusion status.
Estimated response parameters (onset delays, rise times, decay times, dead times, and time constants) with uncertainty and sample sizes.
Machine-readable development/validation episode counts, fitted FOPDT parameters, held-out validation R2 and RMSE, cadence audit, and error diagnostics.
Raw response curves for P301 startup pressurization comparing development and held-out validation episodes against fitted FOPDT trajectory.
Raw response curves for P301 shutdown depressurization comparing development and validation episodes against decay model.
Raw response curves for MV201 motorized valve opening stroke and FIT201 flow acceleration.
Raw response curves for MV201 motorized valve closing stroke and FIT201 flow cutoff.
Demonstration that FIT101 does not respond to P101 state transitions and is strictly governed by MV101.
Multi-panel executive summary plot contrasting the three relationships.
Assessment of proposed candidate delay bounds against empirical raw data.
Documented limitations, process state confounding (MV302), instrumentation misidentification (P101/FIT101), and next steps.
Main scientific report synthesizing raw dynamic validation findings and decisions.
Pytest execution logs verifying 13/13 unit tests passed.
